verdicts.reason: A is jammed: the headline touches the top edge and its 'fizz' runs into the overlapping circles, the CTA pill nearly touches the right and bottom edges, the bottle is clipped at the top and bottom, and the body copy wraps into a cramped three-line block, so the strip reads as packed with no margins. B keeps the original's centred stack (logo, headline, body, CTA) with the bottle on its peach circle, so it stays clean and on brand, but the body copy and CTA label are tiny at this size, the bottle runs edge to edge, and the large green circle on the right leaves dead space.
